title: Token-aware onboarding visuals: contrast overhaul & new glyph family for dark mode
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Produce a small, audit-friendly asset kit of onboarding/quickstart screenshots and micro-illustrations that meet WCAG AA+ contrast in both light and dark themes, use an updated glyph family optimized for small sizes, and avoid any token/API exposure in examples. This ticket focuses on the visual design and export-ready assets; engineering work to wire assets into the product is tracked separately. Deliverables include 8 annotated screenshots (light+dark variants), a 16px and 24px glyph set (SVG + optimized PNG), and a token-safe copy guide for content writers and PMs.
acceptance_criteria: All UX screenshots reach at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for large UI elements in both light and dark themes
Glyphs (16px/24px) render cleanly at 1x and 2x on target devices and match the new visual language
Example prompts and API snippets in screenshots redact or example-ify any real tokens/keys and follow token-safety guide
Deliverables uploaded to Drive with versioned filenames and an index file; PRD and visual QA checklist linked
Design handoff includes annotated specs for spacing, color tokens, and focus states for devs and content team
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff — scoped deliverables with PM (Sanjay Patel) and Eng lead (Lena Park). Confirmed goal to target WCAG AA for body copy across themes.
2026-03-04: Explored three glyph directions. Eliminated 'rounded-heavy' option due to stroke-filling issues at 16px. Proceeding with condensed geometric family.

2026-03-06: Prototype screenshots for Quickstart flow created (steps: signup, API-key modal, first request). Replaced live API key text with structured placeholder <REDACTED_API_KEY> per token-safety checklist.

2026-03-08: Accessibility review with SSO Compliance (Priya Rao). Identified contrast fail on dark-gray dashed focus ring; updated to 3px solid accent for keyboard focus and 4.8:1 contrast against dark bg.
2026-03-10: Engineering sync — agreed export formats and naming convention. ENG-2749 will implement theme-aware image loader. ENG-2811 will accept new icon sprites and SVGs.
2026-03-12: Visual QA pass — all light screenshots pass 4.7:1; dark variants for the API modal achieved 4.6:1 after color tweaks. Preparing Drive upload and handoff notes.
notes: Trade-offs: using a slightly higher stroke weight for 16px glyphs increases file weight by ~3% but greatly improves legibility at 1x on Windows and older Chrome surfaces.
Decision log: We will use semantic placeholders in screenshots (e.g., <EXAMPLE_PROMPT>, <REDACTED_API_KEY>) rather than blurred text to keep copy legible for localization teams.
Next steps: finalize SVG exports, generate optimized PNG fallbacks, upload to Drive, create a 1-page 'how to use' for writers and customer success, and open ENG handoff ticket for runtime wiring.
